Nina: PR #3667 is ready - migration tips for prefix caching + a new JS snippet. Requesting reviews from @Omar and @Leo. Target merge during the 14:00 PT docs slot. Main items: enforce sentence-case headings, ban 'we' in favor of 'Redwood', align JS + Python snippets, and repair a bad anchor in the deployments table.

DocsBot: preview generated - https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3667 - status: failing (1 lint: header case; 1 broken anchor).

Omar: I'll take headings and lexicon changes. Which anchor is broken?

Nina: The deployments table anchor changed to /docs/deployments#capacity-comparison. Also change any "model serving" mentions to "inference runtime".

Leo: I'll check snippet parity. Please ensure both examples use the same deterministic mock response and single-line output. Also prefer lowercase language markers in code fences.

Sasha: Small voice nit: replace casual phrasing like "just do X" with "use X" or "configure X". Also add a brief 4-item migration checklist near the top.

Omar: Pushed heading fixes and lexicon updates in commit omar/docs-3667.

Leo: Found disparity: JS snippet included extra 'meta' field. Pushed patch to trim to {"id":"r1","text":"OK"}. Also switched code fence to ```javascript.

DocsBot: preview updated - https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3667 - status: failing (preview diff: example output mismatch resolved; anchor fixed pending).

Nina: Thanks. Omar can you fix the relative link? Might be a trailing slash.

Omar: Fixed link, removed trailing slash. Also shortened checklist bullets to under 12 words.

Leo: Approved (snippet parity confirmed). :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Approved after voice tweak. :thumbsup:

Omar: Approved. Preview green now?

DocsBot: preview is green - https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3667

Nina: Merging in 14:00 PT slot. Thanks all for quick reviews.
